name: Healthdirect Australia — autism
description: Australian national health information about autism signs, seeking assessment and specialist diagnosis.
intended_use: National orientation for autism assessment in Australia before checking state/territory or local implementation.
audience_or_context: Australia; national public health information. Actual service access and professional availability can vary by state, territory and locality.
limitations: National information does not establish one uniform public assessment pathway in every state or territory.

cost_or_access_notes: Free public health information; assessment cost and access vary.
